verdict.rationale: Veriff documents its own Postman collection for its Public API. A Postman collection is a machine-readable API description that could serve as an OpenAPI equivalent. However, probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any standard path (all 404), and the llms.txt is a documentation index, not an API spec. Missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec file, documented direct download or export of the Postman collection, and independent confirmation of how complete the collection is.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Click here to test Veriff Public API collection in Postman.
